title: Update SecretsManagerBackend to support multi-team
body:

---
Updated the `SecretsManagerBackend` to support multi-team. `team_name` is forwarded to the `_get_secret()` method via `get_variable()` or `get_conn_value()`. If team_name is passed we construct the path to be: `{prefix}/{team_name}/{secret_id}`, if not the path remains how it was previously:`{prefix}/{secret_id}`. Added two additional test cases to ensure get_conn_value and get_variable work correctly when team_name is provided.

closes: #65372
